note: One CARD per (picture, wallpaper group); `counts.clips` is how many distinct pictures that is, and `counts.total` how many cards. A card that stands for several catalogue records names them in `siblings` — the same animation catalogued under different clockworks, or the same two-colour function read by several rules — and a card whose picture is also carded in another film group names those groups in `alsoIn`. Cards whose clips LOOK alike are folded: one per cluster per family is shown by default and carries `look` + `alike`, the rest carry `look` + `alikeOf` and are mounted only when the reader opens that chip. `counts.distinct` is what the page opens with and `counts.folded` what it holds back; neither is a card the manifest dropped.
